module.title: Events
module.noSiteText: Create your first site to receive events, check their coverage and inspect their lineage.
module.noEnvironment: This site has no environment yet.

common.error: The data could not be loaded. Try again.

reasons.consent_missing: No consent signal was recorded, so the event was not stored.
reasons.consent_denied: The visitor did not grant the purpose this event needs.
reasons.gpc_opt_out: Global Privacy Control is on: no marketing or personalization.
reasons.purpose_not_granted: The purpose this destination requires was not granted.
reasons.inferred_data_not_exportable: Inferred values must never reach an advertising platform.
reasons.destination_paused: The destination is paused or not connected.
reasons.pii_blocked: The event contained a secret, card or IBAN and was rejected.
reasons.bot: The request looked like a bot.
reasons.duplicate_event: The same event id was already received.
reasons.duplicate_conversion: This order was already reported on the same path.
reasons.verified_supersedes_browser: A verified server record replaced the browser observation of this order.
reasons.cross_path_pair: The order was also seen on the other path; both are kept and deduplicated by the vendor.
reasons.invalid_event_name: The event name is not valid.
reasons.timestamp_out_of_window: The client timestamp is too far from the server time.
reasons.invalid_url: The page URL is not valid.
reasons.no_config: No configuration is published for this environment, so nothing is routed.
reasons.no_destinations: The published configuration has no destinations.
reasons.policy_blocked: Every mapped destination was blocked by the consent policy.
reasons.destination_disabled: The destination is disabled in the configuration.
reasons.browser_only: The destination runs in the browser only.
reasons.not_mappable: The connector produced no payload for this event.
reasons.destination_missing: The integration or its configuration no longer exists.
reasons.circuit_open: The destination is temporarily paused after repeated failures.
reasons.credential_expired: The credential is missing or expired.
reasons.timeout: The vendor did not answer in time.
reasons.unreachable: The collector could not be reached.

overview.title: Events
overview.intro: What the active environment received, stored, deduplicated and delivered, where the pipeline is stuck, and the three tools to check coverage, inspect lineage and run controlled tests.
overview.noDay: No events were processed in the last 24 hours, so there are no numbers to show.
overview.noEventsYet: No event has reached this environment yet.
overview.deadLettersHint: Deliveries the worker gave up on after repeated vendor errors. They stay until they are replayed from the Destination Health Center.
overview.lineageOffText: The lineage table (migration 0007) is not applied yet. The explorer derives the stages from the stored state without stage timestamps until it is.

coverage.title: Event Coverage Matrix
coverage.text: Every relevant event against browser source, server source, consent, required parameters, data quality and destinations — with the repair action per cell.

explorer.title: Live Event Explorer
explorer.text: Browser and server events with their full lineage: captured, accepted, normalized, policy, deduplicated, routed, delivered or rejected. Redacted payloads, vendor responses and drop reasons in plain language.

testLab.title: Live Test Lab
testLab.text: Guided PageView, Lead, AddToCart, Checkout and Purchase journeys through the real collector in the test environment — consent decision, deduplication, routing and the real test response of each destination.

overview.empty: No events in the last 7 days.
overview.emptyText: Install the snippet or send a test journey; accepted and dropped counts per event appear here.

coverage.title: Event Coverage Matrix
coverage.intro: Relevant events as rows — from the event plan, the event definitions and what was observed — against the sources, consent, required parameters, data quality and destinations of the active environment. Every cell shows its status, the last time and the next repair step.
coverage.noPlanText: This environment has no published configuration and no event definitions. The rows below come from observed events only; run the AI setup to define which events matter.
coverage.emptyText: No event plan, no event definitions and no observed events in the last 7 days.
coverage.caption: Coverage of the last {days} days per event

legendText.info: working as configured, worth a look

messages.stale: Seen in the window, but not in the last 24 hours.
messages.missing: Expected for this event, nothing received in the window.
messages.notExpected: This source is not configured for the event.
messages.consentClean: No event was blocked by consent; no delivery was skipped.
messages.consentBlocked: {blocked} of {received} received events blocked by consent; {skipped} deliveries skipped.
messages.consentSkipped: {skipped} deliveries skipped because a purpose was not granted.
messages.noRequired: No required parameters for this event.
messages.paramsComplete: All required parameters present in the last {sampled} events.
messages.paramsMissing: Missing in some of the last {sampled} events: {missing}.
messages.noDestinations: No destination configured for this site.

explorer.title: Live Event Explorer
explorer.intro: Every browser and server event of the active environment with its full lineage. Payloads are redacted, identifiers masked; vendor responses and drop reasons are shown in plain language. The list refreshes itself while the page is open.
explorer.stale: The workspace changed in another tab. Reload the page to see the active site.
explorer.lineageOffText: Migration 0007 is not applied, so stages are derived from the stored state and rejected events before storage are not listed.

list.title: Events
list.emptyText: Widen the time window, clear the filters, or send a test journey from the test lab.

rejected.title: Rejected before storage
rejected.text: Events the pipeline dropped without storing them: invalid, bot, no consent or PII. Only name, source, stage and reason are recorded.
rejected.empty: Nothing was rejected in the window.

workspaceBanner.text: This link belongs to another site ({site}).

detail.title: Event detail
detail.select: Select an event to see its lineage, consent decision, routing and vendor responses.
detail.notFound: This event is not in the active site or was deleted by retention.
detail.derivedOnly: No lineage rows were recorded for this event; the stages are derived from the stored state.
detail.noAttempts: No delivery attempts for this event.
detail.noRelated: No other event shares this order id or session.
detail.redactionNote: Free text is redacted, identifiers are masked, hashed user data is listed by field only.
detail.strippedIdentity: no identifiers (removed by the consent policy)

testLab.title: Live Test Lab
testLab.intro: Guided test journeys through the real collector in the test-mode environment of this site. Each run sends controlled test events with an ephemeral key, is audited, and shows the consent decision, deduplication, redacted payload, routing and the real test response of every destination.
testLab.unavailableText: Migration 0007 is not applied, so runs cannot be recorded.

environment.noneText: This site has no environment in test mode. Runs need a staging or test environment so nothing reaches production destinations.
environment.sending: Test events go to {environment} ({kind}, test mode) through {host}.

testLab.permission: Running a journey requires the Developer role or higher. You can inspect past runs.

page_view.title: PageView
page_view.text: One page view. Checks capture, consent and routing of the basic event.

lead.title: Lead
lead.text: Page view and a lead form submission.

add_to_cart.title: AddToCart
add_to_cart.text: Page view, product view and add to cart with one test item.

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.text: Page view, product view, add to cart and checkout start.

purchase.title: Purchase
purchase.text: Page view, checkout and a purchase with a test order id — sent twice to show the order deduplication.

consent.label: Consent state of the test visitor

all.title: Analytics and marketing granted
all.text: Events are stored with identifiers and may reach every mapped destination.

analytics.title: Analytics only
analytics.text: Events are stored; advertising destinations are skipped by the policy.

none.title: No consent signal
none.text: Non-operational events are rejected before storage; a purchase is stored without identifiers.

confirm.title: Send test events?
confirm.text: The events go through the real collector and the real pipeline of the test environment.
confirm.nothingProduction: Nothing reaches a production destination: the events are flagged as test events, are never billed, and destinations receive them in their test mode only. The run and the ephemeral key are audited.

notes.audited: Every run creates an ephemeral source key for the test environment (valid for two minutes, revoked right after the request) and an audit entry.

errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to run test journeys.
errors.not_found: The site was not found in this organization.
errors.no_test_environment: This site has no environment in test mode.
errors.unavailable: The test lab is not available (migration missing or collector host not configured).
errors.unreachable: The collector could not be reached. Is the collector running?
errors.generic: The run could not be started.

collector.accepted: The collector accepted the batch (HTTP {status}). The timeline below fills as the worker processes it.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.none: Run a journey to see its timeline here.
timeline.waitingText: The collector accepted the batch; the stages appear as soon as the worker processes it.
timeline.workerHintText: The batch was accepted more than 90 seconds ago but no stage was recorded. Check that the worker is running and that migration 0007 is applied, then refresh.
